study: Exploratory leave-one-source-component-out sensitivity after fixed document splits proved underpowered
reason: The preregistered fixed split had insufficient validation/test counts in all strata. Those results remain unchanged. This separate audit uses no validation set or hyperparameter selection.
dataset: Same previously explored 468-row ChEMBL snapshot, no new independent cohort
grouping_code: scripts/affinity_v4.py:grouping; global union of shared documents/compounds and optionally scaffolds
hyperparameter: Ridge alpha10 is frozen from the previously published v3 validation choice on overlapping data. This dependence makes this analysis exploratory; it is not nested model selection or independent confirmation.
folds: Within each target/endpoint, hold out every component once; all other components train. Require >=40 training rows per fold. Report every skipped fold, its test size, overall coverage and component count. No changing threshold or holding out selected publications only.
features: Morgan radius2,2048 bits,chirality true; Ridge solver lsqr,tol1e-6
metrics: Per stratum: pooled out-of-component MAE/RMSE/R2/Spearman, equal-component mean MAE, selected-minus-training-mean component bootstrap 95% interval (2000 repeats seed42). Formal aggregate metrics require >=2 evaluated components and >=15 evaluated rows; otherwise descriptive fold results only.
limits: Training minimum can exclude large-component test cases; coverage must be disclosed
No whole-herb binding or clinical efficacy interpretation
